subject: TAM escalation exercise and incident communication plan
messages:
From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@tidewater.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-security@tidewater.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: TAM escalation exercise + incident comms sync

Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our procurement checklist we need to validate Redwood's TAM escalation paths and notification cadence in a short tabletop exercise. Specifically, we want:

- Confirmation of primary/secondary TAM contacts and on-call rotations for production incidents
- Clear mapping of severity levels to notification channels (email/SMS/phone) and SLA targets for first response
- Example incident communication timeline we'd expect during a P1 outage (customer-facing bullet points)
- A short 30–45 minute run-through with our ops/security team the week of Aug 2 if possible

Can you confirm who from Redwood would attend, provide a one-page runbook and a sample notification timeline? We prefer a recorded call and a PDF runbook to attach to our RFI.

Thanks,
Avery
Avery Collins
Head of Ops Security | Tidewater Financial
avery.collins@tidewater.com
Office: +1 415 555 2410

Attachment: tidewater-rfi-questions.pdf (we attached our baseline questionnaire)

We'll also include an escalation worksheet that maps severity -> channels -> SLA targets. Drafts attached.

If that works I will follow up with a calendar invite and a Doc recording consent note.

Quick internal notes / adjustments before we send the invite to Tidewater: 

- On-call rotation: Primary TAM listed above. Secondary should be Steph or Marissa as fallback; I recommend we list 2 backups in the runbook and not include full personal numbers in the public PDF.
- Notification channels: For P1 we use phone + SMS + email to primary TAM and pager to SRE. For P2 email + Slack + 2-hour initial response SLA. Add explicit escalation to Security & Legal for incidents with data-scope risk.
- Timeline template: I'll tighten the P1 timeline to 0–15m detection, 15–30m customer notification (initial), 30–90m internal triage update cadence, 4–8h targeted mitigation update.

We should also prepare a short 'what we will not disclose' line for the RFI (internal postmortem details). Karthik, can you confirm pager routing behavior if primary TAM is unavailable?

- Laura
